description: **Gold Diary keeps a simple diary of your gold: every change is noted with its source, so you see what a session was worth and what eats your money.**
## Features
- Sorts every gold change by source: loot, quests, vendor, repairs, Auction House, mail, trainer, flight paths, trade, barber and transmog.
- Three views: this session, today and the last 7 days, each with earned, spent and net gold.
- Net gold per hour for the current session.
- Gold moved to or from the Warband bank or a guild bank is listed on its own and never counts as earned or spent.
## How to use
Type `/gd` (or `/golddiary`) to open or close the diary. `/gd reset` starts a new session. Drag the window anywhere, the position is saved. Escape closes it.
## In detail
### Where the gold came from

Gold Diary looks at which window is open when your gold changes, such as a vendor, the mailbox or the loot window. A window closed less than 1.5 seconds earlier still counts, because some payments arrive late. If several are open, trade, Auction House and mail come first. Quest rewards are matched by their amount, even when the gold arrives a moment early. What no window explains is listed as Other.
### Repairs and banks

The Repair All button at a vendor is booked as Repairs. When the guild pays, nothing is booked, since your own gold stays the same. Gold you put into or take out of a bank appears as "Moved to/from banks" and leaves earned, spent and net alone. Buying a bank tab counts as Other.
### Session, today and 7 days

Three buttons switch the view. The session starts when you log in or type `/gd reset` and is not saved, so a reload starts a fresh one. Today and 7 days add up the saved daily totals of your current character, by local date. Each view lists only the sources that moved gold.
### Gold per hour
The session view adds your net gold per hour. It appears after the first minute and updates every five seconds while the window is open, green for a gain and red for a loss.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail, inside and outside of instances alike. It reads no combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons, and no chat.
- The addon is in English.
- Auction House gold counts as Mail when you take it from the mailbox.
- Daily totals are saved per character and kept for 60 days. The window shows up to the last 7.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
